name: Adjudication hours per decided case (completion rate)
definition: Average staff working time, in hours, that the authority estimates it needs to decide one request of a given type (for fee setting or staffing). Not the time applicants wait (see processing_time). Breakdown form=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (USCIS completion rates in the EB-5 fee rules). Use breakdown form=.

name: Share of applications submitted by a group of agents
definition: Percentage of the applications decided, vetted or submitted in a period that were filed through a stated group of agents (category=, e.g. the four busiest agents), as printed. Never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10 (Malta regulator, 2019-2020 report).

name: Applications for an agent licence
definition: Applications received from firms seeking a licence or selection as a programme agent (marketing/intermediary or due-diligence agent) in a call or period. Breakdown category= for the type of agent. Not licences granted (agents_licensed).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-mne1. Proposed by extract-cbi-mne1 (Montenegro's 3 Jan 2019 calls for intermediary and due-diligence agents). Complements agents_licensed.

name: Licence fee per agent
definition: Fee an agent, promoter or marketing firm pays the programme authority for its licence or marketing rights, per agent and per period, as stated in a contract or report (category= names the agent type or firm). Total fees collected go in cbi_fee_revenue.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Outcome rate of an agent's applications
definition: Percentage of the applications filed through one agent (or a stated agent within a group) that ended with a stated outcome, category= approved or not_approved (with the agent group in the category name), as printed. Agents are not named in the breakdown.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10 (Malta regulator, 2019-2020 report: best and worst of the four busiest agents; one firm's agent under review).

name: Licensed programme agents
definition: Agents or intermediaries (persons or firms, as the source counts them) licensed or accredited by the programme authority to submit applications, at a date. Breakdown category= for the type of firm.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-hun-mlt-eur. proposed by extract-hun-mlt-eur for Malta's IIP accredited persons/agents (OR-GCES reports 2014 and 2019-2020).

name: Share of licensed agents by type
definition: Percentage of the agents licensed or accredited by the programme authority at a date that belong to one type of firm or profession (category=), as printed. Counts are agents_licensed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10 (Malta regulator tables of agents by type, 2017-2024).

name: Agents through whom applications were submitted
definition: Licensed agents (intermediaries) through whom the applications decided, vetted or submitted in a period were filed, as counted by the source. Breakdown category= for groups the source defines (e.g. the busiest agents, agents with all or none of their applications approved, agents by number of applications submitted). Not the number of licensed agents (agents_licensed).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10 for the Malta regulator's "Agents' Performance" statistics (2019-2020 report, p. 12).

name: Number of nationalities among applicants
definition: Number of distinct nationalities among a programme's applicants or grantees in a period, as printed. A count of countries, not of people.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-gbr1. proposed by extract-cbi-gbr1 for the MAC Tier 1 (Investor) report (2014), para 2.47 (71 nationalities).

name: Applicant share
definition: Percentage of a programme's applicants, approved applicants or naturalised persons (the stage is given by applicant= or stage= and the notes) who belong to one group: a nationality (nationality=, country=, or a region of nationality as category=), sex (sex=), age, education, employment or other personal trait (category=), investment option chosen (route=), or region of the investment (region=). Printed by the source, never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11); replaces applicant_nationality_share and the indicators merged into it.

name: Application appointments
definition: In-person appointments, attendances or pre-bookings for programme applications at an office, per day or in a period (category= for per-day peak or a single booking).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Investment stated for one application
definition: Investment or donation amount stated for one application in a source's list of individual applications (breakdown item=, route=). Not a total, not an average, and not necessarily paid.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Applications approved
definition: Applications approved in a period (decision date), first-time applications unless noted; renewals excluded. Unit applications counts files; unit persons counts people in them.

name: Approved applications by year filed
definition: Applications eventually approved, counted by the period in which they were filed (not the decision period), as of the source date. Excludes rejected, withdrawn or pending.
notes: added by research:cyprus. Cyprus Audit Office chart of the 3,517 approved investor applications. Not comparable with applications_received. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Applications approved in principle
definition: Applications given approval in principle (conditional approval before the investment is made and the visa granted), counted cumulatively from a start date or in a period, including those later granted. A flow, not the current stock (stock goes in approvals_in_principle_outstanding).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:oceania. New Zealand Active Investor Plus reports both forms in different versions of its page.

name: Share of applications decided
definition: Percentage of the applications received in a period that had been decided (granted or denied) by its end, as printed. Not a grant rate (applications_grant_rate).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Application grant rate
definition: Grants as a percentage of decisions or of all finalisations (grants, refusals, withdrawals) in a period, as printed; notes give the base. Never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus2. proposed by extract-cbi-aus2 for the "Grant Rate" rows of the Australian Migration Program reports (BIIP comparison tables, 2018-19 to 2024-25 reports).

name: Applications lapsed
definition: Applications closed without a decision on the merits and classified by the source as lapsed (separately from withdrawals), in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-gbr1. proposed by extract-cbi-gbr1 for the UK entry clearance table vi_01_q (Tier 1 - Investors: Applications, Resolved, Granted, Refused, Withdrawn, Lapsed).

name: Applications pending
definition: Applications filed but not yet decided at a date (a stock), whatever year they were filed. Main applicants unless the breakdown says applicant=family (family members only) or applicant=main_and_family (both); initial and renewal unless permit_type= says.
notes: added by research:greece. Stock at a date. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Applications processed
definition: Applications decided (approved plus denied, and other closures where the source counts them) in a period, whatever the filing date.
notes: added by research:grenada. Can exceed applications received when backlogs are cleared Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Applications received
definition: Applications filed in a period, main applicants unless noted; first-time applications, excluding renewals and family members' own files unless noted. Unit applications counts files, unit persons counts people included.

name: Change in applications received (percent, as stated)
definition: Percentage change in applications received between a period and an earlier period, or average annual growth over several years (breakdown measure=average_annual_growth), as printed by the source when it gives no counts. Never calculated by us; notes give the comparison.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for the St Kitts CIU Chairman's December 2025 update ('A 169% increase in applications'). Where counts are printed, record them as applications_received instead.

name: Applications rejected
definition: Applications denied in a period (decision date), first-time unless noted; renewals excluded.

name: Applications rejected, by year filed
definition: Applications rejected by the source date, counted by the period in which they were filed (not the decision period). First-time unless permit_type=renewal.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-grc. added by extract-grc for the Greek Ministry of Migration annex tables (Πίνακας 13α/13β). Figures for recent filing periods grow as pending files are decided.

name: Applications withdrawn
definition: Applications withdrawn by the applicant (or deemed withdrawn, e.g. investment not made in time) before a decision, in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally added by research:closed-west. Proposed by research:closed-west (Ireland). Not added as rows yet: the only figure found is 'approximately 500' for 2012-2022 (answer of 28 Feb 2023). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Applications withdrawn or revoked, by year filed
definition: Applications withdrawn or revoked ("ανακλήσεις") by the source date, counted by the period in which they were filed. First-time unless permit_type=renewal.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-grc. added by extract-grc. The Greek tables do not define "ΑΝΑΚΛΗΣΕΙΣ"; it can mean withdrawal of the application or revocation of the decision.

name: Applications withdrawn or declined (combined)
definition: Applications that ended without approval where the source prints withdrawals and refusals as one number, in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:oceania. Use applications_rejected / applications_withdrawn when the source splits them.

name: Approved files awaiting issue
definition: Approved applications whose permit, card or certificate has not yet been issued at a date because the applicant has not completed the last steps (fee payment, biometrics, collection). Not visa-number waits (petitions_approved_awaiting_visa).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Approvals-in-principle outstanding (stock)
definition: Applications holding an approval in principle but not yet final approval, at a date (a stock).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:hong-kong-taiwan. Hong Kong CIES: the Immigration Department's 'Approval-in-principle granted' column. Cumulative approvals-in-principle granted (e.g. New CIES) go in applications_approved with breakdown stage=approval_in_principle.

name: Bank client relationships refused or ended over programme links
definition: Client relationships linked to the programme that banks refused to open (category=refused) or ended (category=terminated) in a period, as reported by the supervisor or banks.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Nicolatos report ch. 12).

name: Programme cases meeting a stated condition (review of files)
definition: Programme cases (applications or investors, as counted) that a review or audit of files found to meet a stated condition, over the review period. Breakdown category= names the condition.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-irl1. proposed by extract-cbi-irl1 for the Irish Department of Justice review of investment-based naturalisation (Feb 1998), Appendices B and D, which give yes/no counts per condition. Companion to cases_not_meeting_condition.

name: Programme cases not meeting a stated condition (review of files)
definition: Programme cases that a review or audit of files found not to meet (or found no evidence for) a stated condition, over the review period. Breakdown category= names the condition.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-irl1. proposed by extract-cbi-irl1; companion to cases_meeting_condition.

name: Programme case files under external inquiry
definition: Programme cases whose files are held by or referred to a tribunal, court, police, prosecutor or other external inquiry, at a date. Not a finding of wrongdoing.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-irl1. proposed by extract-cbi-irl1 for the Irish answer of 14 Dec 2004: files on 128 persons naturalised under the investment scheme were with the Moriarty tribunal.

name: Balance of a CBI-related government account
definition: Balance at a date of a government account or fund held for, financed by, or named after a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme (e.g. CIU deposit accounts, contingency or savings funds financed from CBI receipts, the Malta NDSF). Breakdown category= names the account. Not applicants' escrow money (cbi_escrow_balance).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-kna-vut. Proposed by extract-kna-vut (St. Kitts 2016 audit report, inactive deposit accounts "CIU Contingency Account" and "Office of the Prime Minister/CIU"). Narrower savings funds keep cbi_contingency_fund_balance.

name: Agent commissions paid abroad, share of GDP
definition: Estimated outflows of commissions paid to programme agents abroad, as a percentage of GDP, as given by the source (usually an IMF staff adjustment). Stored with the source's sign: an outflow printed as -4.5 is stored as -4.5.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11), approved by Oscar.

name: Donations by programme applicants to local entities
definition: Donations by programme applicants to local charities, NGOs, cultural, sport or other entities in a period, as reported by the programme authority (unit currency; unit donations for the number of donations). Not the government fund contribution (cbi_contributions).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-hun-mlt-eur. proposed by extract-hun-mlt-eur for Malta IIP donations (OR-GCES 2019-2020 report, Table 28 and Appendix B). Not the government development-fund contribution.

name: Programme board attendance
definition: Percentage of programme board meetings attended by a member (category= the member's role; names are not recorded) or the lowest attendance among members, as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Programme board meeting time
definition: Total time the programme board spent in meetings in a period, in the units printed (hours and minutes are stored as separate rows category=hours_part / minutes_part, never converted).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Programme board meetings
definition: Meetings held by the board or committee that decides programme applications or oversees the programme agency, in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: CBI government bond purchases
definition: Value of government bonds bought by programme applicants as their qualifying investment, in a period.
notes: added by research:saint-lucia. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: CBI inflows recorded in the capital account, share of GDP
definition: CBI inflows recorded in the balance-of-payments capital account, as a percentage of GDP, as given by the source.
notes: added by research:st-kitts-nevis. Distinct from budgetary CBI fees recorded as services exports Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: People covered by listed fund contributions
definition: People (main applicants and dependants) covered by the fund contributions in a programme unit's list for a period, as printed in the list's total row.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-atg. Proposed by extract-atg. Antigua CIU NDF contribution lists print persons and dollars in the total row.

name: CBI contributions collected
definition: Donations/contributions paid by applicants into the government's CBI or development fund in a period, gross (before any share kept by the CBI unit); excludes property purchases, other investments and fees.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally added by research:antigua-barbuda. Same definition as proposed in the Malta inbox file. For Antigua: NDF contributions listed in CIU six-monthly reports. Reviewed 2026-09-28. Merged with cbi_fund_contributions (research:saint-lucia): in Saint Lucia the CIU keeps 20% and remits 80%, so check each row's notes for gross or net.

name: Number of fund contributions (donations) received
definition: Number of fund contributions (donations) received in a period, or budgeted, as printed. A count of contributions/applications paid, not of people.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-lca1. Proposed by extract-cbi-lca1 for the Saint Lucia CIU 2017/18 report (111 donations received vs 200 budgeted).

name: Fund contributions held by the CBI unit pending remittance
definition: Fund contributions collected by the CBI unit but not yet paid over to the government or fund, at a date (or added to that balance in a period).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-lca1. Proposed by extract-cbi-lca1 for the Saint Lucia CIU accounts (NEF money held in trust at year end, 2020-2025).

name: CBI contributions as a share of GDP
definition: Gross CBI fund contributions as a percentage of GDP, as calculated by the source.
notes: added by research:malta. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Fund contributions approved but not yet collected
definition: Gross fund contributions owed by approved applicants but not yet collected, at a date.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-lca1. Proposed by extract-cbi-lca1 for the Saint Lucia CIU 2017/18 report (EC$20,479,500 outstanding at 31 March 2018).

name: Court award relating to CBI money
definition: Amount a court orders a party to pay the state in connection with CBI proceeds.
notes: added by research:historical. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: CBI dividend paid to citizens
definition: Cash payments to citizens or residents financed from, and named after, CBI revenue (e.g. St Kitts and Nevis "CBI dividend"), in a period. Status budget for appropriations, actual for spending.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-kna-vut. Proposed by extract-kna-vut for the St. Kitts audit reports 2022-2023.

name: CBI dividend paid to citizens, share of GDP
definition: CBI dividend payments as a percentage of GDP, as given by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for IMF St Kitts 2025 Article IV Table 2 (row "CBI dividend").

name: People receiving a CBI dividend
definition: People who received a CBI dividend payment in a round or period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna2. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna2 for the St Kitts 2024 Budget Address ('about 17,500 individuals in its inaugural round'). Companion to cbi_dividend_payout (amount).

name: Entities receiving applicant donations
definition: Number of local entities (charities, NGOs, cultural, sport or other bodies) that received donations from programme applicants in a period or cumulatively, as printed. Breakdown category= for groups by number of donations received. Amounts and numbers of donations are cbi_applicant_donations.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10 (Malta regulator reports 2019-2020 to 2024).

name: CBI money due to the government (calculated)
definition: CBI money that programme statistics calculate as due to the government from applications approved in a period (budget fees and the government's share of contributions), before collection or transfer. Breakdown category= for its parts. Not cash received.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-grd-lca-dma-atg. Proposed by extract-grd-lca-dma-atg for Grenada's Ministry of Finance CBI statistics ('Amounts Due to Government', 2022; 'Earmarked for general government financing', 2019, a running total). Not cash: compare cbi_transfers_to_government.

name: Programme money held in applicants' escrow accounts
definition: Money deposited by applicants in escrow accounts and not yet released to the project, fund or government (typically for undecided applications), at a date. Breakdown route= for the purpose.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-mne1. Proposed by extract-cbi-mne1 for the Montenegrin status reports of 2026 (escrow balances for tourism projects and for the Innovation Fund). Not a government account, so not cbi_account_balance.

name: CBI fees collected by the programme unit
definition: Processing, due-diligence, passport, agent-licence and similar fees collected by the programme unit in a period; excludes donations and investments.
notes: added by research:antigua-barbuda. Antigua CIU operating account; not the same as cbi_fiscal_revenue. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: CBI revenue to government
definition: CBI money counted as government revenue in the fiscal accounts in a period (usually fund contributions and fees, not real-estate purchases). Breakdown category= for components.

name: Change in CBI revenue to government (percent)
definition: Year-on-year percentage change in CBI revenue to government, as printed. Never computed from levels.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-vut1. Use only when the source prints the change; never computed from levels. Companion to cbi_fiscal_revenue.

name: Share of CBI revenue from one component
definition: Percentage of CBI revenue (or the unit's collections) in a period that came from one component (contributions, application fees, due-diligence fees), as printed. Breakdown category=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-kna-vut. Proposed by extract-kna-vut for the St. Kitts 2016 audit report, which gives only a share (92% "Citizenship by Investment fees"). Where amounts are printed, record them as cbi_fiscal_revenue with category= instead.

name: CBI money as a share of government expenditure
definition: CBI money received by government in a period as a percentage of total government expenditure, as calculated by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for the St Kitts 2023 Budget Address ('funded 63.5 percent of the Government's Total Expenditure' in 2021). Different denominator from cbi_fiscal_revenue_pct_revenue.

name: CBI revenue to government as a share of GDP
definition: CBI revenue to government as a percentage of GDP.

name: CBI share of non-tax revenue
definition: CBI revenue to government as a percentage of non-tax revenue, as printed. Never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-atg2. Proposed by extract-cbi-atg2 for Antigua and Barbuda budget speeches ('nearly 60 per cent of non-tax revenue'). Kept apart from cbi_fiscal_revenue_pct_revenue because non-tax revenue is a much smaller denominator than total revenue.

name: CBI receipts as a share of operating cash receipts
definition: CBI money collected by government as a percentage of total receipts from operating activities in the government cash-flow statement, as calculated by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-kna-vut. Proposed by extract-kna-vut for the St. Kitts audit reports (2018: 32%, 2019: 36%). Different denominator from cbi_fiscal_revenue_pct_revenue (recurrent or total revenue).

name: CBI share of government revenue
definition: CBI revenue to government as a percentage of total government revenue (with or without grants: notes).

name: Money credited to a CBI-financed account or fund
definition: Money credited in a period to an account or fund financed by a programme, as listed by the unit (contributions and any other receipts). Breakdown category= names the account. Wider than cbi_contributions.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-atg. Proposed by extract-atg (Antigua NDF monthly credits 2016; Renewable Energy Escrow credits). Not the same as cbi_contributions, which counts only applicant donations.

name: Losses of a CBI-financed fund
definition: Amount of a CBI-financed fund reported lost, written off or missing, usually cumulative to a date.
notes: added by research:historical. Stock-like, usually cumulative to a date; often only press figures Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Payments out of a CBI-financed account or fund
definition: Money paid out in a period from an account or fund financed by a programme (unit operating account, development fund, escrow fund), as listed. Breakdown category= names the account and/or payee.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-atg. Proposed by extract-atg for the Antigua CIU six-monthly reports (operating-account disbursements approved by Cabinet, NDF payments, Renewable Energy Escrow payments).

name: Money recovered for a CBI-financed fund
definition: Amounts recovered through settlements or court awards for losses of a CBI-financed fund.
notes: added by research:historical. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Public facilities built with programme money
definition: Public facilities (health centres, schools...) built or completed with programme money, as stated. Breakdown category= for the type. Homes go in cbi_funded_housing_units.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma1. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma1 for Dominica budget addresses (e.g. twelve Health and Wellness Centres completed with CBI funding, 2022/23 address).

name: Homes built with programme money
definition: Dwellings built, under construction, contracted or handed over with programme money, as stated. Breakdown category= for site or stage.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma1. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma1 for Dominica, where post-hurricane housing was built under the CBI programme (Montreal Management Consultants, Bellevue Chopin and other sites). Not the same as properties bought by applicants (properties_acquired_for_cbi).

name: Homes planned in approved programme projects
definition: Dwellings that approved programme projects plan to build, as set out in the approved business plans or project approvals, counted when the project is approved. Not homes built, under construction or handed over (those go in cbi_funded_housing_units). Breakdown category= for the type of housing (e.g. social_housing).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar).

name: Spending on a CBI-financed public project, percent of GDP
definition: Total cost of, or spending in a period on, a public project the source says is financed mainly by CBI revenue, as a percentage of GDP. Breakdown category= for the project; notes say total cost or period outlay.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma1. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma1 for IMF Dominica reports on the new international airport, "financed through CBI resources" (estimated cost 65 percent of GDP in the 2021 Article IV, 59 percent of 2022 GDP in the 2023 Article IV).

name: Programme contribution to GDP or GDP growth (estimate)
definition: Contribution of a programme to the level of GDP or to GDP growth over a stated period, in percent, as estimated by an official study. category= says which.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Ministry of Finance impact study relayed in the Nicolatos report).

name: CBI inflows
definition: All money paid into a programme in a period (fund contributions, real-estate purchases and fees), as defined by the source.
notes: Definitions differ between sources; check notes on each observation

name: Programme investment inflows as a share of foreign direct investment
definition: Programme investment inflows in a period as a percentage of gross foreign direct investment inflows, as stated.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl2 for EPRS PE 627.128 (2018), p. 41 (Portugal: RBI inflows 'as much as 13 % of estimated gross foreign direct investment inflows for 2014', from IMF WP/15/93).

name: CBI inflows as a share of GDP
definition: All programme inflows as a percentage of GDP.
notes: Often an IMF staff estimate

name: Debt payments linked to CBI revenue
definition: Payments to creditors in a period whose amount is tied to programme revenue under a debt agreement (e.g. Grenada bondholder CBI payments), as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-grd1. Proposed by extract-cbi-grd1 for the 'Bondholder CBI-related payments' line in IMF Grenada Article IV fiscal tables (CR 25/39, CR 26/9).

name: Debt payments linked to CBI revenue, percent of GDP
definition: CBI-linked debt payments as a percentage of GDP, as calculated by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-grd1. Proposed by extract-cbi-grd1 (IMF Grenada Table 3b).

name: Jobs linked to programme investors
definition: Workers employed (not necessarily newly created jobs) in the businesses or projects of programme investors, at a date or in a period, as stated.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally added by research:egypt-jordan. Proposed by research:egypt-jordan for Jordan, whose routes are tied to job creation. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Programme money against its target
definition: Programme money in a period compared with the target, budget or programme expectation for it, as printed: the amount above or below it (currency), as a percentage of GDP (unit percent_of_gdp), as a percentage of the target (unit percent_of_target) or as a multiple of it (unit times_target). category= names the item and the direction (e.g. ima_revenue_above_target, ciu_programme_cost_below_budget). Neither level is implied; never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Used for Grenada IMA collections, St Kitts CBI receipts against the IMF stand-by programme, and Saint Lucia CIU revenue, costs and deficit against budget. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Government spending on running a CBI programme
definition: Money the government appropriates or spends in a period on running a programme (due diligence, consultancy, marketing, unit operating costs). Status budget for appropriations, actual for spending. Breakdown category= for the cost type.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-kna-vut. Proposed by extract-kna-vut for St. Kitts appropriation warrants (2018 consultancy/operations and marketing; 2020-2021 due diligence and operating costs).

name: Programme running costs as a share of government spending
definition: Spending (or budgeted spending) on running a programme as a percentage of total (recurrent) government expenditure, as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma2. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma2 for the Dominica estimates, whose "analysis of recurrent expenditure" tables print object 354 (CBI marketing and due diligence) as a share of total recurrent expenditure (17.0% in 2018/19 to 11.1% in 2025/26).

name: Government spending on running a CBI programme, share of GDP
definition: Government spending on running a programme (e.g. CBI due-diligence costs) as a percentage of GDP, as given by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for IMF St Kitts Article IV tables (General Government Fiscal Operations in percent of GDP, row "of which: CBI due diligence costs").

name: Staff working on a programme
definition: Staff assigned to, or planned for, administering a programme at a date or for a period; unit says what is counted (persons, full-time equivalents, positions), as printed. Breakdown category= for office or grade.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (additional FTEs in the USCIS EB-5 fee study).

name: Programme staff movements
definition: Staff movements at the programme agency in a period: hires, resignations, terminations, promotions. Unit persons for counts; unit percent_of_movements when the source prints each type's share of all movements; unit percent for a printed change against the previous period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Programme staff with a trait
definition: Percentage of the programme agency's staff with a stated trait or outcome (category=: e.g. professionally certified, average retention rate), as printed. Never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Hotel rooms in programme real-estate projects
definition: Hotel rooms (keys) in a real-estate project approved as a qualifying programme investment (planned, under construction or completed: status and notes). Breakdown category= for the project.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma1. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma1 for Dominica budget addresses and IMF reports, which describe CBI real-estate hotel projects (Range Kempinski, Jungle Bay, Anichi/Marriott, Tranquility Beach/Hilton Curio...) by room count. A planned count is status projection; an opened hotel actual.

name: Public cost of a programme project
definition: Cost to the public purse (spending, guarantees, concessions or losses) attributed to a programme-linked project, as stated by the source; category= for the project. Political statements take status claim.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Investment projects approved for a programme
definition: Real-estate or business projects approved as qualifying investments for a programme in a period (or at a date). Breakdown route=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-atg. Proposed by extract-atg (Antigua CIU overview table, 2015).

name: Programme projects completed
definition: Real-estate or business projects built as qualifying programme investments that are completed in a period (status actual) or expected to be completed (status projection). Breakdown category= for the type (e.g. hotel). Not approvals (cbi_projects_approved).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Programme projects covered by monitoring reports
definition: Programme investment projects covered by the monitoring reports counted in project_monitoring_reports.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-mne1. Proposed by extract-cbi-mne1, paired with project_monitoring_reports.

name: Planned investment in approved programme projects
definition: Total investment planned (e.g. in business plans) for projects approved as qualifying investments. Not money paid by applicants. Status projection.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-mne1. Proposed by extract-cbi-mne1 for the Montenegrin government reports of 2021 (List of development projects in tourism). Status projection.

name: Investment through CBI and RBI schemes
definition: Total investment associated with CBI and RBI schemes of several countries combined (e.g. EU-wide EPRS estimates).
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Used for EU-wide EPRS estimates Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: People granted citizenship or residence through investor schemes
definition: Persons (including family members) obtaining citizenship or residence via investor schemes, several schemes or countries combined.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Used for EU-wide EPRS estimates Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: CBI real-estate investment inflows
definition: Money paid by applicants into approved real-estate projects in a period; not government revenue.
notes: added by research:grenada. Complements cbi_fiscal_revenue; together roughly equal cbi_inflows Merged with cbi_real_estate_investment (research:saint-lucia). Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Programme real-estate purchases as a share of all property transactions
definition: Value of real-estate purchases by programme applicants as a percentage of the value of all real-estate transactions in the country or area, in a period, as stated.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-hkg. Proposed by extract-hkg (Hong Kong CIES, LegCo LCQ7 of 23 Feb 2011: about 1%).

name: CBI rejection rate
definition: Rejections as a percentage of applications or decisions in a period, as defined by the source.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Often rejections in year / applications in year, not a cohort rate Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Public revenue lost through programme irregularities (estimate)
definition: Public revenue an official audit or inquiry estimates was lost through programme irregularities (e.g. reduced VAT wrongly applied, contributions not collected). Breakdown item= for the type.
notes: added by research:cyprus. Use breakdown item=... for the type of loss. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: CBI revenue missing or diverted
definition: CBI money that should have reached the state but did not (diverted, embezzled, never transferred), as estimated by an inquiry, prosecutor or auditor.
notes: added by research:historical. Estimates by inquiries differ hugely; always check the source's method Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: CBI receipts saved, share of GDP
definition: Part of CBI receipts in a period that the government saves rather than spends, as a percentage of GDP.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-misc2. proposed by extract-cbi-misc2 for the IMF 2012 Article IV on Comoros (ECP windfall: 1.8% of GDP saved in 2012). No existing indicator covers savings out of CBI receipts as a flow.

name: Programme-linked share of bank remittances
definition: Percentage of incoming bank remittances in a country in a period that are linked to the programme, as reported by the central bank or banks.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Central Bank of Cyprus governor testimony, Nicolatos report).

name: Recommended savings buffer from programme revenue, share of GDP
definition: Size of precautionary (stabilisation) savings built from programme revenue that a source estimates as adequate or recommends, as a percentage of GDP; value_high for a range. category= for the basis of the estimate. Status estimate. Not an actual fund balance (ndf_assets_pct_gdp, cbi_account_balance).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Suspicious-transaction reports concerning programme clients
definition: Suspicious-transaction reports filed with the financial intelligence unit concerning programme applicants or transactions, in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Nicolatos report ch. 12).

name: CBI money transferred to government
definition: Money remitted by the programme unit to the treasury or to a government or national development fund in a period (net contributions, bond proceeds, surplus transfers), as defined by the source. Breakdown category= names the destination or component.
notes: added by research:saint-lucia. Components differ by source; see notes on each row. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Programme agency cash flows
definition: Lines of the statement of cash flows of the agency that runs a programme in a period (operating, investing and financing flows, working-capital changes, distributions to government, cash at start and end). category= names the line; outflows printed in brackets are stored as negative numbers.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Programme agency balance sheet
definition: Items of the statement of financial position of the agency that runs a programme (cash, receivables, prepayments, property plant and equipment, payables and accruals, provisions, deferred income, lease liabilities, totals, equity) at a date, and the movements in those items that the report or its notes print (additions, depreciation, amounts recognised, increases and decreases, percentage changes, working capital ratio). category= names the item; unit percent or ratio for printed changes and ratios. Accounts of the agency, not of the government fund (cbi_account_balance).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10. Covers Saint Lucia CIU audited statements and summary balance sheets; percentage changes and the working capital ratio are kept as printed, never computed. Proposed by extract-cbi-newind-2026-10-10.

name: Net income of the programme agency
definition: Net income of the agency running the programme in a period. Breakdown category= for the measure printed (net_operating_income, net_income_before_tax, net_income_after_tax).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-other. Proposed by extract-other (Philippine Retirement Authority).

name: CBI unit revenue
definition: Operating revenue of the agency running the programme (fees, retained share of contributions, administrative fees) in a period.
notes: added by research:saint-lucia. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: VAT on programme investors' property (computed)
definition: VAT on property bought by programme investors, computed by an audit at the rate named with item=, for a stated group of properties.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Cyprus Audit Office special report 2022, reduced-VAT table).

name: Program citizenships revoked
definition: Persons whose programme citizenship (or the investment certificate it rests on) was annulled or withdrawn, completed revocations; main applicants plus dependants unless applicant= says (applicant=main for investors only).
notes: added by research:turkey. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Payment out of a CBI unit's operating account
definition: One payment (cheque, wire or transfer) out of a citizenship-by-investment unit's operating account, as listed line by line by the programme (one row per payment). Period is the date of the payment (day precision); breakdown item= carries the cheque or transfer reference. The payee's kind (government body, company, international organisation, charity, or 'individual' without the name) and the printed purpose are in notes. Money.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-atg-lists-b. Proposed by extraction passes extract-cbi-atg-lists-a/-b for the Antigua and Barbuda CIU six-monthly reports (Appendix V, 'Operating Account Disbursements'). Currency not printed in the 2020-2024 lists; rows are XCD with unit_basis guessed (the 2015 H2 edition heads the same list 'Amount EC$').

name: Petitions to remove residence conditions approved
definition: Petitions to remove the conditions on an investor's conditional permanent residence (e.g. US I-829) approved in a period.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Petitions to remove residence conditions denied
definition: Petitions to remove residence conditions (e.g. I-829) denied in a period.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Petitions to remove residence conditions pending
definition: Petitions to remove residence conditions (e.g. I-829) awaiting a decision at a date (a stock).
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Stock at a date. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Petitions to remove residence conditions decided
definition: Petitions to remove residence conditions (e.g. I-829) decided in a period (approvals plus denials, plus other closures where counted).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4 for the "Total Completions" column of the USCIS all-forms reports.

name: Petitions to remove residence conditions received
definition: Petitions to remove residence conditions (e.g. I-829) filed in a period.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Responses to a public consultation on a programme
definition: Written submissions, roundtables or other responses received in a government consultation or review of a programme; unit says what is counted. Breakdown category=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus1. proposed by extract-cbi-aus1 for the December 2020 Home Affairs BIIP review report (41 written submissions, nine roundtables).

name: Current account balance excluding CBI receipts
definition: External current-account balance excluding CBI receipts recorded in it, as a percentage of GDP, as given by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for IMF St Kitts Article IV balance of payments tables.

name: Dependants approved
definition: Family members granted residence or citizenship derived from a main applicant, in a period.
notes: added by research:greece. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Dependants granted citizenship
definition: Family members (spouses, children, other dependants) naturalised through the programme in a period, excluding main applicants. applicant= gives the relationship (spouse, child, minor_dependant, adult_dependant...).
notes: added by research:turkey. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Family members per application
definition: Average number of family members per main application or main applicant (in addition to the main applicant), as printed; unit as printed (persons, ratio, persons_per_principal).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl2 for EPRS EAVA PE 694.217 (2021), Annex II: 'an average of 1.61 family members are included on each application' across EU RBI programmes.

name: Share of applicant documents verified
definition: Percentage of a type of supporting document that a processing office verifies with the issuing authority, at a date.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus1. proposed by extract-cbi-aus1 for a Nov 2019 Home Affairs email (FOI FA 20/08/00701).

name: Due diligence reports, orders or interviews handled by a provider
definition: Due-diligence reports, orders, subjects, requests or interviews a programme's due-diligence provider handled in a period; unit says what is counted. Breakdown category= for firm and measure.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-lca1. Proposed by extract-cbi-lca1 for the due diligence firms' sections of the Saint Lucia CIU annual reports 2023/24 and 2024/25 (S-RM, BDO, Exiger, FACT).

name: Eligibility applications approved
definition: Applications passing a preliminary eligibility or due-diligence stage that allows a full application (two-stage schemes), in a period.
notes: added by research:malta. Kept apart from applications_approved to avoid mixing stages. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Investment funds eligible for a programme
definition: Funds licensed or registered whose units qualify as a programme investment, at a date or over a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Nicolatos report ch. 10, CySEC).

name: Enquiries received by the programme
definition: Enquiries from prospective applicants received by the programme authority in a period. Not applications.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-hkg1. Proposed by extract-cbi-hkg1 for the Hong Kong New CIES press release of 7 Jan 2025 ('Number of enquiries Nearly 7 000' in the first 10 months).

name: EU aid to Sugar Protocol countries
definition: EU funds for accompanying measures for Sugar Protocol countries. Context series.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: EU reference price, raw sugar
definition: Legislated EU reference price for raw sugar, per tonne, by marketing year. Context series.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: EU reference price, white sugar
definition: Legislated EU reference price for white sugar, per tonne, by marketing year. Context series.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Council Regulation (EC) No 318/2006 Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Expressions of interest submitted
definition: Expressions of interest lodged in an invitation system before any invitation to apply, at a date or in a period (notes say stock or flow).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus1. proposed by extract-cbi-aus1 for SIV EOIs by nominating government (FOI FA 20/08/00701, EOIs as at 31 March 2019).

name: Change in programme fees, percent
definition: Change in a programme's government fees in percent, as set or estimated by the authority (e.g. in a fee rule's impact analysis). Negative = decrease. category= says which fee or average.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11), approved by Oscar.

name: Overall balance excluding CBI revenue (amount)
definition: Central government overall balance excluding programme revenue, in currency, as calculated by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma1. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma1 for IMF Dominica Article IV statements of operations in EC$ ("Overall balance (excl. CBI)"). The amount counterpart of fiscal_balance_excl_cbi_pct_gdp.

name: Fiscal balance excluding CBI proceeds
definition: General government overall balance excluding CBI proceeds, as a percentage of GDP.
notes: added by research:malta. Usually an IMF staff figure. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Cases on which the programme agency worked with the financial intelligence unit
definition: Programme cases on which the programme agency collaborated with the financial intelligence unit in a period, other than cases it reported itself (those are cbi_suspicious_transaction_reports), as stated.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10 (Malta regulator, 2019-2020 report p. 16: 51 cases).

name: Fraud tips and complaints about a programme received
definition: Tips, complaints and referrals about possible programme-related fraud received by an authority in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4 (GAO-15-696: over 100 SEC tips Jan 2013-Jan 2015).

name: Enforcement actions over investor-programme fraud
definition: Civil or criminal enforcement actions over programme-related fraud brought by an authority, cumulative to a date or in a period.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Open fraud investigations involving the programme
definition: Investigations concerning a programme open at a date.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Stock at a date. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Age of programme participants at a grant
definition: Age of people when granted residence or citizenship through (or after) a programme: a range (value to value_high) or an average (notes), as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-sgp2. Proposed by extract-cbi-sgp2 for Singapore written answer of 1 Aug 2017 (67 GIP PRs granted citizenship at ages 25 to 58). Age-bracket shares stay in applicant_profile_share.

name: Programme applicants identified as high risk
definition: Applicants or approved persons identified by an authority, inquiry or study as high risk (PEPs, sanctioned, convicted, charged), in a period. Breakdown category=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl2 for EPRS EAVA PE 694.217 (2021), Annex II p. 29: Cyprus, 97 high-risk individuals out of 2,500 applications (54 PEPs, 43 convicted).

name: Dwellings sold to foreigners (proxy)
definition: Dwellings sold to foreign nationals in a period, from land-registry data. Context/proxy, not a count of programme purchases.
notes: added by research:turkey. Turkey: TurkStat from TKGM; excludes persons of Turkish origin and those under Law 4112. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Immigrant visas issued abroad
definition: Immigrant visas issued by consular posts abroad under the programme categories in a period, principals plus family. Excludes adjustments of status.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. US EB-5: State Department Report of the Visa Office, Table VI (Part IV), '5th Total'. Counted by foreign state of chargeability (normally country of birth). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Change in investment certificates issued (percent, as stated)
definition: Percentage change in investment certificates issued between two periods, as printed. Never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-pan1. Proposed by extract-cbi-pan1 for MICI Panama (27 July 2023: 'un incremento de 100% en comparación con el mismo periodo del año anterior'). Companion to investment_certificates_issued; analogous to applications_received_change_pct.

name: Investment eligibility certificates issued
definition: Certificates confirming a qualifying investment issued (a step before the residence/citizenship decision), in a period; unit as printed (certificates, persons, investors, applications).
notes: added by research:turkey. Turkey: 'uygunluk belgesi' / 'Taşınmaz Yatırımı Tespit Belgesi' Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Investment certificates in one period as a percentage of another (as stated)
definition: Investment certificates of one period or group as a percentage of those of another stated period or group, as printed. Never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-pan1. Proposed by extract-cbi-pan1 for MICI Panama press releases (13 Dec 2024: 84% of 2023's certifications issued in July-October 2024; 5 Feb 2025: about 70% of 2024's certified investors applied in July-December 2024).

name: Investor funds misused or misappropriated (per case)
definition: Amount an authority alleges or finds was misused or misappropriated from programme investors in a specific case. Case-level.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. Case-level, not a programme total. Notes must say whether the amount is an allegation (status claim) or adjudicated (court finding, plea, restitution order). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Investor visa applications
definition: Applications for an entry visa that is a required first step before an investor residence permit (e.g. Hungary's guest-investor visa).
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. added by research:hungary-latvia. Kept apart from applications_received (permit stage). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Investor visas issued
definition: Investor entry visas granted (first stage before the residence permit), in a period.
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. added by research:hungary-latvia. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Investors per pooled-investment entity
definition: Average, median or other distribution statistic of the number of programme investors per project, enterprise or intermediary, as computed by the source. Breakdown category= names entity and statistic.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3.

name: Invitations to apply issued
definition: Invitations to apply for an investor visa issued in a period to people who lodged an expression of interest.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus1. proposed by extract-cbi-aus1 for Australian SIV invitations (FOI FA 20/08/00701).

name: Share of programme grants found not to meet the rules
definition: Percentage of approved applicants (or passports) that an audit or inquiry found did not meet a programme condition, as printed. Breakdown category= for the condition.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl2 for EPRS EAVA PE 694.217 (2021), p. 30, citing the Cyprus Attorney General's inquiry: 12% without a permanent residence, 8% without the required investment.

name: Irregular naturalisations detected
definition: Persons found by authorities to have obtained programme citizenship irregularly, whether or not yet revoked.
notes: added by research:turkey. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Irregular investor residence grants detected
definition: Persons found by an authority to have obtained investor-linked residence irregularly, whether or not withdrawn.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-other. Proposed by extract-other for the Oman State Audit Institution finding (2024 Society Summary, p. 40). Residence counterpart of irregular_naturalisations_detected.

name: Long-term ("golden") residence permits issued, all categories
definition: Long-term ("golden") residence permits issued in a period across all eligibility categories (investors, talent, professionals, family...), not limited to investors.
notes: added by research:uae. Use residence_permits_issued (with breakdown route=...) for investor-only counts. UAE figures are mostly Dubai (breakdown emirate=dubai). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Share of lump-sum taxpayers or revenue in a group of regions
definition: Percentage of lump-sum taxpayers, or of lump-sum tax revenue, located in a stated canton or group of cantons, as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-che1. proposed by extract-cbi-che1 for the 2011 Federal Council message (73.9% of lump-sum taxpayers and 77.8% of cantonal and communal revenue in VD, VS, TI and GE).

name: Tax paid per lump-sum taxpayer (lowest, highest or average)
definition: Lowest, highest or average tax collected from one person taxed on a lump-sum (expenditure) basis in a period (category=lowest/highest/average), as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-che1. proposed by extract-cbi-che1 for the FDK surveys of Swiss cantons (lowest and highest lump-sum tax 2008-2018; average CHF 180,162 in 2018).

name: Tax revenue from lump-sum (expenditure-based) taxation
definition: Tax collected in a period from people taxed on a lump-sum or expenditure basis, all levels of government unless category= says.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:europe-rest.

name: People taxed on a lump-sum (expenditure) basis
definition: People taxed on their living expenses instead of income and wealth, at a date (a stock).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:europe-rest. For tax-residence regimes for wealthy foreigners. Not a count of permits.

name: Main applicants approved
definition: Main applicants granted citizenship or residence in a period; first grants only.

name: Projected minimum investment amount
definition: Government projection of a programme's minimum investment amount after future automatic adjustments under stated scenarios. Not a term in force.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (EB-5 Modernization rule Table 4).

name: CBI development-fund assets as a share of GDP
definition: Accumulated assets of a CBI-financed development or savings fund as a percentage of GDP.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: CBI development-fund surplus as a share of GDP
definition: Income minus spending of a CBI-financed development fund in a period, as a percentage of GDP.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for IMF WP/15/93 Box 5 (SIDF surplus 2007-2013).

name: NDF contribution of one CBI application
definition: The National Development Fund contribution recorded for a single citizenship-by-investment application in a programme's own application-by-application list, as printed (one row per listed application). Breakdown nationality= gives the applicant's nationality as printed (ISO alpha-3; nationality=unknown when the list prints no recognisable country). Period is the date the application was submitted (day precision). Money; excludes fees and other investment routes.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-atg-lists-b. Proposed by extraction passes extract-cbi-atg-lists-a/-b for the Antigua and Barbuda CIU six-monthly reports (Appendix III). Currency is not printed in these lists; rows are USD with unit_basis guessed. Summing rows reproduces cbi_contributions where the list is complete.

name: Subsidised credit backed by a CBI-financed development fund, percent of GDP
definition: Below-market credit backed by deposits of a CBI-financed development fund, as a stock (category=facilities_outstanding) or annual subsidy (category=annual_subsidy), as a percentage of GDP.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl3. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl3 for IMF WP/15/93 Box 5 (SIDF facilities 'about 1.5 percent of GDP by end-2013', subsidies 'about 0.05 percent of GDP per year'). No existing indicator covers NDF-backed lending.

name: CBI development-fund spending as a share of GDP
definition: Spending of a CBI-financed development fund in a period, as a percentage of GDP. Breakdown category= for components.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for IMF WP/15/93 Box 5 (SIDF operations 2007-2013). Companion to ndf_income_pct_gdp.

name: CBI development-fund income as a share of GDP
definition: Income of a CBI-financed national development fund in a period as a percentage of GDP; category=cbi_contributions when only CBI contributions are counted.
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Separate from cbi_fiscal_revenue, which covers the central budget Merged with cbi_ndf_income_pct_gdp (research:st-kitts-nevis); may include investment income, see row notes. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: CBI passports issued
definition: Passports issued to people who got citizenship through the programme in a period (unit passports, or persons where the source counts people).
notes: added by research:antigua-barbuda. Close to persons_naturalised but counts passports; Antigua's CIU reports it by year, and the yearly series changes between report vintages. Reviewed 2026-09-28. Merged with cbi_passports_issued (research:context-timeline). Passports can exceed persons naturalised (renewals).

name: Valid permanent residence permits (stock)
definition: People holding a valid permanent residence permit on a date, for the categories the source covers (may include non-investors).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:africa-indian-ocean. Proposed by research:africa-indian-ocean for Mauritius (EDB annual report).

name: People granted citizenship
definition: Persons naturalised through the programme in a period (main applicants plus dependants unless noted).

name: Persons naturalised without a stated document
definition: Persons naturalised through a programme who, according to the source, did not provide a stated document (category=, e.g. birth_certificate). Usually a claim; not a finding that the naturalisation was irregular.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10. Proposed by extract-cbi-mlt-images-2026-10-10 (an MP's claim of 58 IIP citizens without their own birth certificate, relayed in the 2019-2020 regulator report).

name: Approved investor petitions awaiting a visa number
definition: Approved investor petitions whose principals have not yet obtained residence because no visa number is available, at a date. Petitions, not people.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Stock at a date; measures the visa backlog, not demand. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Primary balance excluding CBI revenue (amount)
definition: Central government primary balance excluding programme revenue, in currency, as calculated by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma1. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma1 for IMF Dominica Article IV statements of operations in EC$ ("Primary balance (excl. CBI)"). The amount counterpart of primary_balance_excl_cbi_pct_gdp.

name: Primary balance excluding CBI revenue, percent of GDP
definition: Central government primary balance excluding programme revenue, as a percentage of GDP.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-grd1. Proposed by extract-cbi-grd1 for IMF Grenada 2016 Article IV Table 1 ('Primary balance (excl. CBI revenues)'). The primary-balance counterpart of fiscal_balance_excl_cbi_pct_gdp.

name: Government cost per application processed
definition: Average cost to the government of processing one programme application to a final decision in a period (total processing costs divided by applications processed), as printed by the source. Never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11; new categories approved by Oscar). proposed by research:extract-cbi-fullcopies-2026-10-10. proposed by extract-cbi-fullcopies-2026-10-10 for the CIC 2014 BIP evaluation, Table 6.2 (Investor class $1,984 per application; text $1,958).

name: Processing time
definition: Time within which a programme authority decides or screens a type of application, at a date, in the unit printed (days, weeks or months; value_high for a range or extendable maximum). Breakdown form= or stage for what is timed, category= or measure= for mean, median, percentile, maximum or goal; status budget for targets. Never converted.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11); replaces processing_time_months and the indicators merged into it.

name: Share of applications by processing-time band
definition: Percentage of applications (approved unless noted) decided within a band of time from filing. Breakdown category= for the band.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Cyprus Audit Office special report 2022, p. 30 pie chart).

name: Programme participants who left
definition: People or households in an investment-migration or wealthy-resident regime who left the country or region in a period, as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-che1. proposed by extract-cbi-che1 for the 2011 Federal Council message (92 of 201 lump-sum-taxed households left Zurich by end-2010 after cantonal abolition).

name: Programme filings approved (other forms)
definition: Filings under a programme's forms other than the main investor petition and the petition to remove conditions (e.g. EB-5 regional-center designation I-924/I-956, project I-956F, annual statements I-924A/I-956G, bona fides I-956H, promoter I-956K) approved in a period. Breakdown form=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4; companion of programme_filings_received.

name: Programme filings denied (other forms)
definition: Filings under the other programme forms (as for programme_filings_approved) denied in a period. Breakdown form=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4.

name: Programme filings pending (other forms)
definition: Filings under the other programme forms awaiting a decision at a date (a stock). Breakdown form=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4 (USCIS all-forms "Pending").

name: Programme filings decided (other forms)
definition: Filings under the other programme forms decided in a period. Breakdown form=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4 (USCIS all-forms "Total Completions").

name: Programme filings received (all or other forms)
definition: Filings under the other programme forms received (or forecast) in a period; empty breakdown = the source's all-form total. Breakdown form=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 for the EB-5 fee rules (Forms I-527, I-956F, I-956G, I-956H, I-956K and all-form totals). Investor petitions stay in applications_received, I-829 in conditions_removal_petitions_received, I-956 in regional_center_applications_received.

name: Average characteristic of programme migrants
definition: Average of a characteristic of programme migrants or their businesses other than income (years of experience, businesses owned, ownership share, tax paid), as printed; category= says what, unit gives its unit.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-can1. proposed by extract-cbi-can1 for the CIC 2014 evaluation of the federal Business Immigration Program (survey and IMDB averages for Investor class immigrants).

name: Income of programme migrants
definition: Typical annual income (average, median or approximate, as stated) of programme migrants in a period. Breakdown applicant= and category=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus2. proposed by extract-cbi-aus2 for the 2023 Review of the Migration System, Figure 49 (approximate incomes of Investor visa primary applicants by age, ABS Census 2016).

name: Programme migrants counted in a study
definition: Number of programme immigrants (or applicants) counted in a study population, such as tax records or survey respondents; usually the 'out of' number behind printed percentages. category= names the group. Printed by the source, never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11), approved by Oscar.

name: Programme share of a combined budget or cost
definition: Percentage of the costs of a wider government programme or budget line attributable to the investor programme, as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-can1. proposed by extract-cbi-can1 for the CIC 2014 BIP evaluation (Investor class 56.6% of BIP costs 2006/07-2011/12).

name: Programme grants as a share of all grants of the same status
definition: Percentage of all first residence permits (category=first_residence_permits) or all naturalisations (category=naturalisations) in a country in a period granted through the investor programme, as printed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl2 for EPRS PE 627.128 (2018), Table 1 (RBI permits as % of all first-time residence permits) and p. 18 (share of naturalisations through the CBI scheme).

name: Programme holders switching to another immigration route
definition: People holding programme permission who were granted permission in another immigration category in a period. category=to_<new category>.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-gbr1. proposed by extract-cbi-gbr1 for UK Home Office Exe_D02 (extensions by previous category of leave, 2015-2020).

name: Monitoring reports on programme projects adopted
definition: Independent monitoring reports on programme projects adopted by the government or authority, cumulative to a date or in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-mne1. Proposed by extract-cbi-mne1 (Montenegro: Government adoption of independent controllers' reports on tourism development projects). The number of projects covered goes in cbi_projects_monitored.

name: Project proposals declined
definition: Investment project proposals declined as qualifying investments in a period. Breakdown route=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-nzl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-nzl2 (NZTE acceptable-investment decisions for Active Investor Plus).

name: Project proposals awaiting a decision
definition: Investment project proposals awaiting a decision at a date (a stock).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-irl2. proposed by extract-cbi-irl2 for the Irish IIP wind-down, where about 90 project proposals were still undecided in July and December 2025 alongside 1,400-1,600 investor applications (applications_pending counts main applicants, so it does not fit).

name: Project proposals received
definition: Investment project proposals (businesses or funds seeking to become qualifying investments) submitted in a period. Breakdown route=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-nzl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-nzl2 for NZTE's assessments of businesses and managed funds applying to be acceptable Active Investor Plus investments (MBIE briefing, Oct 2024). Companions: cbi_projects_approved, project_proposals_declined, project_proposals_withdrawn, project_proposals_pending (proposed by extract-cbi-irl2).

name: Project proposals withdrawn
definition: Investment project proposals withdrawn before a decision in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-09 (decision 11). Originally proposed by research:extract-cbi-nzl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-nzl2 (NZTE acceptable-investment decisions for Active Investor Plus).

name: Properties acquired for citizenship
